name: Achievement
definition: To accomplish meaningful goals and succeed at what I set out to do

name: Adventure
definition: To be adventurous; to actively seek, create, or explore novel or stimulating experiences

name: Assertiveness
definition: To respectfully stand up for my rights and request what I want

name: Authenticity
definition: To be authentic, genuine, real; to be true to myself

name: Beauty
definition: To appreciate, create, nurture or cultivate beauty in myself, others, the environment, etc.

name: Challenge
definition: To keep challenging myself to grow, learn, improve

name: Community
definition: To be part of and actively contribute to my community

name: Conformity
definition: To be respectful and obedient of rules and obligations

name: Courage
definition: To be courageous or brave; to persist in the face of fear, threat, or difficulty

name: Creativity
definition: To be creative or innovative

name: Curiosity
definition: To be curious, open-minded and interested; to explore and discover

name: Diversity
definition: To value, respect, and appreciate a wide range of people, perspectives, and ways of life

name: Empathy
definition: To understand and share the feelings of others

name: Encouragement
definition: To encourage and reward behavior that I value in myself or others

name: Equality
definition: To treat others as equal to myself, and vice-versa

name: Fairness
definition: To be fair to myself or others

name: Family
definition: To be close to, supportive of, and invest in my family relationships

name: Fitness
definition: To maintain or improve my fitness; to look after my physical and mental health and wellbeing

name: Flexibility
definition: To adjust and adapt readily to changing circumstances

name: Freedom
definition: To live freely; to choose how I live and behave, or help others do likewise

name: Friendliness
definition: To be friendly, companionable, or agreeable towards others

name: Forgiveness
definition: To be forgiving towards myself or others

name: Fun
definition: To be fun-loving; to seek, create, and engage in fun-filled activities

name: Generosity
definition: To be generous, sharing and giving, to myself or others

name: Gratitude
definition: To be grateful for and appreciative of the positive aspects of myself, others and life

name: Honesty
definition: To be honest, truthful, and sincere with myself and others

name: Humor
definition: To see and appreciate the humorous side of life

name: Humility
definition: To be humble or modest; to let my achievements speak for themselves

name: Independence
definition: To be self-supportive, and choose my own way of doing things

name: Integrity
definition: To live in alignment with my principles, even when no one is watching

name: Intimacy
definition: To open up, reveal, and share myself—emotionally or physically—in my close personal relationships

name: Kindness
definition: To be kind, compassionate, considerate, nurturing or caring towards others

name: Leadership
definition: To guide, inspire, and bring out the best in others

name: Legacy
definition: To create something lasting; to be remembered and leave a positive mark

name: Love
definition: To act lovingly or affectionately towards myself or others

name: Loyalty
definition: To stand by the people and causes I'm committed to

name: Mindfulness
definition: To be conscious of, open to, and curious about my here-and-now experience

name: Nature
definition: To connect with, protect, and spend time in the natural world

name: Order
definition: To be orderly and organized

name: Patience
definition: To wait calmly for what I want

name: Peace
definition: To cultivate inner calm and contribute to a peaceful world

name: Pleasure
definition: To create and give pleasure to myself or others

name: Power
definition: To strongly influence or wield authority over others

name: Resilience
definition: To continue resolutely, despite problems or difficulties

name: Romance
definition: To be romantic; to display and express love or strong affection

name: Safety
definition: To secure, protect, or ensure safety of myself or others

name: Self-development
definition: To keep growing, advancing or improving in knowledge, skills, character, or life experience

name: Sensuality
definition: To create, explore and enjoy experiences that stimulate the five senses

name: Sexuality
definition: To explore or express my sexuality

name: Simplicity
definition: To live simply and free from unnecessary complexity

name: Spirituality
definition: To connect with things bigger than myself

name: Stability
definition: To have consistency, security, and predictability in my life

name: Tradition
definition: To respect and maintain meaningful customs, rituals, and heritage

name: Trust
definition: To be trustworthy; to be loyal, faithful, sincere, and reliable

name: Wealth
definition: To acquire, create, save or increase wealth

name: Wisdom
definition: To gain and apply knowledge and experience
